app.title: NCTD Manifest Parser
app.subtitle: Converts the NCTD trip manifest into the TOBI import format
app.footer: North County Transit District · NCTD Manifest Parser
s1.title: 1) Data to be processed
s1.hint: Upload the Trips file (XLSX or CSV) and the Passengers list (CSV). Review the preview before processing.
date.applied: Date changed to {date}. Processing will use this date.
date.multiple: The file has several dates ({dates}); the date cannot be changed.
s2.title: 2) Results and search
s2.search: Search by name or Tobi MRN
summary.title: Processing summary
summary.unknownSpaceTypes: Space Type outside the catalog (Ambulatory used): {values}
exc.NONRECIPROCAL_ROUTE: Legs of the same client with no return route
exc.INVALID_LEG_ID: Leg ID has characters that are not allowed
err.FILE_UNREADABLE: The file could not be read.
err.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the 10 MB limit.
err.UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND: The file is no longer available; upload it again.
err.JOB_NOT_FOUND: The result is no longer available; process again.
err.MULTIPLE_TRIP_DATES: The file has several dates ({dates}); the date cannot be changed.
err.NO_VALID_DATE: The file has no valid TripDate.
err.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again.
s2.exportBlocked: Export blocked: {count} rows with an ID collision or ambiguous pairing. Fix the Trips file and process again.
exc.INVALID_CLIENT_NAME_FORMAT: Client Name not in LAST,FIRST format (goes to Invalid Trips)
exc.MISSING_ID_COMPONENT: Missing data needed to build the ID (sent to Invalid Trips)
exc.INVALID_VENDOR_ID: Vendor ID has characters that are not allowed
summary.catalogMigrated: Companions updated to the v2.7 format (-PCA / -COM)
exc.NO_PASSENGER_CATALOG: No Passengers catalog was uploaded: every passenger was treated as new and their data may not match earlier days
exc.CATALOG_DUPLICATE_MRN: MRN Number repeated in the catalog (the first one was used)
exc.CATALOG_PHONE_INVALID: Catalog phone without 10 digits (kept as is)
v2.toggle: Experimental Leg ID V2 mode (TOBI Stage only)
v2.hint: The Leg ID V2 column is always in the Output. With the mode on, a collision or an invalid Leg ID V2 blocks the Output. Do not use in PROD.
v2.modeOn: Experimental mode on: {name}. Use Leg ID V2 as the leg identifier in TOBI Stage.
v2.modeOff: Standard mode: TOBI uses Leg ID as the leg identifier.
exc.INVALID_LEG_ID_V2: Leg ID V2 empty or with characters that are not allowed
v2seq.toggle: Assign consecutive numbers to Leg ID V2
v2seq.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 999999
v2seq.hint: Each Output trip gets L000001, L000002… in file order. To avoid repeating numbers in TOBI, start at the number after the last one of the previous file.
v2seq.done: Consecutive Leg ID V2: {first} to {last}. The next file should start at {next}.
err.INVALID_SEQUENCE_START: The Leg ID V2 start number must be a whole number from 1 to 999999.
exc.LEG_ID_V2_SEQUENCE_OVERFLOW: Consecutive Leg ID V2 numbers would go past L999999
db.hint: The catalog lives in the {table} table. The App reads it by itself when processing, and it only changes when you press “Save to catalog” in the results.
db.connected: Catalog read from the database: {count} passengers.
db.needKey: Type the catalog key and press Connect to be able to process.
db.import: Import a Pasajeros CSV into the catalog (.csv)
db.imported: {filename}: {saved} new passengers saved, {existed} were already in the catalog (kept), {duplicates} repeated in the file.
save.pending: New passengers not yet saved to the catalog: {added}. Corrections to existing passengers: {changed}. Save them before taking the Output to TOBI.
save.none: No new passengers or corrections: the catalog does not change.
save.done: Saved to the catalog: {saved} new passengers and {updated} corrections.
save.already: This result had already been saved to the catalog.
save.stale: {count} passengers were saved by another process while you were reviewing; the catalog kept their data ({ids}). Process the file again before taking the Output to TOBI.
err.CATALOG_KEY_INVALID: The catalog key is not correct.
err.CATALOG_STORE_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the catalog database. Nothing was processed or saved; try again in a moment.
err.CATALOG_STORE_DISABLED: The catalog database is not enabled in this App.
